title: The older kids
text: A group of older kids have started picking on him at the bus stop. He's had enough.

choices.text: He waits for the biggest one and swings first.
choices.outcome: Suspended for a week. Nobody at the bus stop says a word to him again.

person.about: Was there that day, and has had his back ever since.

choices.text: He walks into the boxing gym on the high street.
choices.outcome: The trainer makes him skip for a month before he's allowed to hit anything.

choices.text: He signs up at the jiu-jitsu academy.
choices.outcome: Six months later one of them tries it again and ends up on his back, with the boy calmly on top.
